messages:
Marco: Heads-up — rolling v2 as a 3% canary in prod-west for 20m. watching latency + error-rate slices.
deploy-bot: Canary roll started (rl-1837654321) on cluster-prod-west, routing=3% -> canary.
Sylvie: Noted. Can we add per-route percentile breakdown in the dashboard? current view is aggregate and hides a spike on /embed.
Tanya: Agree — we need route + customer_tier slices. also want seq_len buckets (<=512, 512-2048, >2048). last regression only hit >2048.
Kevin: Is there an exposed UI filter I can hook to that? I can add a quick query: metrics.query("latency_ms", {route: "/embed", bucket: ">2048"}) but need a button in the UI.
Marco: There isn't one yet — dashboard only supports global tags. I propose a "slice" dropdown where you can add multiple dimensions.
Sylvie: Also the alerts are noisy. we had a pager on 0.1% delta yesterday. proposal: alert only if (relative_increase > 10% AND absolute >15ms AND sustained >= 5m).
Tanya: +1 to that. also require a minimum sample size (e.g., >=5k requests or >=50k tokens) to avoid noisy signals on small cohorts.
Kevin: For A/B we should surface per-cohort conversion (success/latency) and show overlap of user ids between cohorts to detect leakage.
Oliver: UX idea — show a traffic heatmap (time vs cohort %) so you can see ramp behaviour instead of a single point-in-time split.
Sylvie: Can we add a "drill to logs" button that runs a prebuilt query for the selected slice (route/customer_tier/seq_len)? would speed investigations.
Marco: Example traffic split config I used for the canary: ```json
{
  "stable": 0.97,
  "canary": 0.03,
  "constraints": [
    {"route": "/embed", "min_samples": 1000},
    {"customer_tier": "enterprise", "max_pct": 0.02}
  ]
}
```
Tanya: Also telemetry: ensure all spans/metrics include rollout_id and variant tags so we can join tracing -> metrics -> logs.
deploy-bot: Metrics stream for rl-1837654321 attached to rollout-dashboard (latency/errors/throughput) — initial batch in ~30s.
Marco: I'll open a PR adding the slice dropdown + sample-count in tooltips and the revised alert rule. pinging @Tanya for review.
Tanya: Reviewing now — will comment on alert thresholds.
Sylvie: i'll run an internal A/B with a small cohort tomorrow to validate slices.
Kevin: add sample counts per slice to the dashboard tooltip please — that was the missing piece yesterday.
Marco: Great. Anything else?
Oliver: One more: surface percent of total tokens per variant so finance can estimate cost delta in the UI.
Marco: Nice. I'll include token sampling and heatmap in the PR. :thumbsup:
